dedupe_keys.name: any town water distribution system walski epanet file

description: Any-town is a hypothetical city distribution system used as an optimisation and rehabilitation benchmark, contributed by Tom Walski to the Water Distribution System Research Database as entry 31. The entry page offers one EPANET zip, and DataCite holds a DOI for the EPANET file; the page links only a PDF whose file name suggests it is shared with other entries, and the summary spreadsheet holds no counts. Coverage is a synthetic town, so no place or date applies beyond the 2016 deposit. The file is free to download; the page states no licence, only a copyright notice of the hosting institute. Only the index page, the entry pages, the summary spreadsheet and DataCite metadata were read; no network file was downloaded or run. The network is used for pipe replacement and rehabilitation planning, pump scheduling, fire-flow and resilience studies, and comparison of optimisation algorithms. Related records: the Anytown datasets generated with DHALSIM, the leakage dataset for Hanoi and Anytown, EPANET and the database record.
